name: (REUPLOAD) Realistic Tank Simulator 2.0
desc:
Engage in epic encounters as a tank commander or infantry, maneuvering across war-torn landscapes to capture vital points. With meticulously detailed tanks, the choice is yours, will you manage to alter the past or preserve the right path?

Beta 0.1.4

On-foot controls
Shift to sprint
C to crouch

Vehicle controls
Click a seat to get on
Q and E to switch between gears (driver's seat)
Shift to aim

Note: This game is meant for gameplay purposes and not to promote or glorify tragic events that happened during the war that costed innocent human lifes in order to comply with Roblox's Terms of Service.
Second note: This game has been reuploaded due to the previous account (HateMyLife1337_2) being wrongfully terminated, because my main got a warning for an image I uploaded 6 years ago.
Third note: This game abandoned and no longer being maintained due to Roblox's policy changes that are meant to be in the name of "safety".
This game is heavily based on HyeonU_U's RTS2.
